examples.title: Compass
examples.text: It is a small circular field instrument with a freely pivoting magnetized needle over a marked direction dial and a transparent cover.

examples.title: Orrery
examples.text: It is a tabletop mechanism with visible gears and several small spherical bodies arranged around a central body to demonstrate orbital motion.

examples.title: Spectroscope
examples.text: The instrument has an entrance slit, optical tube, viewing eyepiece and angular scale and is used to examine separated wavelengths of light.
